programme.desc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。

programme.title: 模範家庭 #5
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開

programme.title: 紙人回魂
programme.desc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的

programme.title: 夜迷藏
programme.desc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: 珍妮花離開虐待她的丈夫後搬進了新公寓。當她準備開展新生活時,卻發現睡覺時總被某些東西咬一口,使她變得睡眠不足和疑神疑鬼,更產生了莫名的恐懼。

programme.title: 罪慾 - 碌葛
programme.desc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安

programme.title: Chop Chop
programme.desc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。

programme.title: 搏盡
programme.desc: 碼頭工人林四海,一次助中央特派專員鄭志成脫險,因而得以加入警局;後告發要員收規,獲局長賞識,升為副官;繼而林藉局長三姨太欠下巨額賭債,唆使局長允其代受賄替三姨太還債;林辭去職務在黑道大展拳腳,復與碼頭總管事梅寶聯盟……

programme.title: 七仙女
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家,為奴以埋父骨;其孝心感動了七仙女,便幻成村姑,在六位仙姐下凡暗助下,為董縮減償還工作日,回復自由後,二人回董故家,但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢?

programme.title: 摩登土佬
programme.desc: 這部音樂喜劇講述青年貝小芬與好友漢堡飽在廣告界內尋找真愛和成就的故事。

programme.title: 太陰指
programme.desc: 故事描述,路天保與兩個結拜兄弟,巧遇奉師命清理門戶的躺棺長髮少女與四行屍人

programme.title: 宋宮秘史
programme.desc: 包公發現劉妃在二十年前為保其位而謀害李妃,將李妃剛誕下的兒子調走後,把她逐出皇宮。於是,包公用妙計誘大太監郭槐認罪,揭發當年他與劉妃合謀陷害李妃之奸計,並將劉妃定罪。而李妃也被接回皇宮,與已為皇帝的兒子團聚。

programme.title: 飛刀手
programme.desc: 綽號飛刀追魂的焦雷與乾坤劍名手于遠結怨,焦要追殺于全家。幸得飛刀手楊青救了于的女兒于英;但楊青生性風流,向于英開出對付焦雷的條件是共渡一夜。于英憎惡他,又不得不和他一起助父親與焦雷決鬥。相處日久,于英才明白楊非登徒浪子,實對她深愛非常。

programme.title: 魚美人
programme.desc: 張珍與金寵之女牡丹早有婚約,金寵卻欲退婚。張珍偶遇化身金牡丹樣子的鯉魚精,兩人漸生情愫。一天,金寵請包公來公斷兩個真假牡丹,包公為成全二人,推辭此案…

programme.title: 江湖三女俠
programme.desc: 故事講述,胸懷野心的朱天翔得知韓氏三姐妹若蘭、如玫、曉蓮家藏威力驚人的玄鐵神劍,若能奪得,必能戰勝「武林之尊」修德武館,稱霸江湖

programme.title: 鬥氣小神仙
programme.desc: 丁安安與雍晴兩個表姐妹自小就讀於同一所女校,因二人的母親一向口和心不和,從小就向自己女兒灌輸好勝思想,因此形成安安與晴從小鬥到大,三日一小吵,五日一大鬥。她們在校中認識了男同學米高及保羅,很快成為情侶,兩對小冤家後來因鬥氣竟然互調了男朋友…

programme.title: 方世玉與胡惠乾
programme.desc: 武當派敗類白眉道人、馮道德、雷老虎等,勾結清廷,甘受驅使來殘殺武林中人,方世玉之父母方濟亨、苗翠花,胡惠乾之父皆為雷等所殺;胡一次尋仇不遂,為方所救,後隨方往少林寺練就高強武功影片最後少林與武當之武林自相殘殺的畫面,出現一幕令人怵目驚心的大結局。

programme.title: 新不了情
programme.desc: 歌女青青與建築師湯鵬南原是一對感情深厚的情侶,可惜好景不常,湯家突遭巨變,青青不惜出賣自己肉體以相助鵬南,想不到竟被鵬南誤會而導致倆人分手。後來鵬南得知事情始末,欲挽回感情,可惜青青已患上絕症。

programme.title: 五遁忍術
programme.desc: 黑道幫主康聯興覬覦武林盟主地位,竟以東瀛武士挑戰武林總盟盟主袁增;一場酣戰,東瀛武士落敗,切腹自殺,死前留下遺書囑康聯興聘請忍者之王劍淵為其復仇。劍淵率領大批忍者前來中土,擺下「五遁陣」,向袁增挑戰。袁增派遣門下八位高手前去破陣,卻因對忍術一無所知,全部被殺。劍淵取得勝利後意猶未足,派出女忍者純子混

programme.title: 鬼屋麗人
programme.desc: 本片是根據《聊齋》中之《書癡》改編,故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺負,搬進常鬧鬼的「孝廉府」。然後玉柱遇上了顏如玉,二人及後結成夫婦。郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉,將其迷奸。良金妻妾更毒害如玉,如玉化成厲鬼,將中元、良金等人殺害。玉柱因如玉已不在人世,不禁一陣辛酸。

programme.title: 萬人斬
programme.desc: 清朝光緒年間,守衛森嚴的大內金庫,竟遭悍匪劫去黃金二萬兩,慈禧太后大為震怒。外號「萬人斬」的京都捕房總捕頭冷天鷹受命於三個月內,緝捕匪首方逢甲歸案。方逢甲佈署大批匪徒喬裝村民,向冷天鷹施以突擊,冷在猝不及防下終告受傷。失明少女方蘭姑讓冷在屋內養傷,未幾,方逢甲突然出現,原來蘭姑乃其獨女

programme.title: 王昭君
programme.desc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她。畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。

programme.title: 王昭君
programme.desc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她。畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。

programme.title: 踩綫
programme.desc: 本片由著名演員王鍾編導,為 1981年的社會寫實電影。故事描述,呂良偉與李修賢在片中均為中越混血兒, 由越南逃至澳門;呂於香港出生,可在港居留,乃與李分散;鄭則仕飾呂之叔父,為一幹練警探,即介紹呂加入員警世界,派其作臥底。後鄭一次與越南匪徒糾鬥中 遭殺害;而李則被牽涉入這宗凶案

programme.title: 黑蜥蜴
programme.desc: 本片改編自著名武俠小說家黃鷹之同名小說。故事講述,丁鵬與蕭立本是同門師兄弟,而丁妻與蕭妻則是兩姊妹。兩家本極為友好,後來丁妻誕下一子,而蕭妻誕下一女,但蕭獨喜子。丁妻為了成全姐夫心願,便來一個男女對換,惟完成此事後便告死去。蕭妻內心有愧,手抱兒子往見丁,不料為蕭暗中看見,頓生綠帽疑雲,狠然佈下瘋子殺

programme.title: 鬼新娘
programme.desc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏,兩人情投意合並私訂終身。婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂,但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害。最終在道士相助下,方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻,然而人鬼殊途,兩人於晨光中淒然訣別,冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世。

programme.title: 小煞星
programme.desc: 強宜本是夜總會歌星,後來為尋初戀女友水仙的下落,被人帶到匪幫的木屋。原來,強宜少年時誤入歧途,有打劫殺人的犯罪紀錄,綽號「小煞星」。一哥要脅他共同打劫珠寶行,否則公開他的秘密。強宜假意應承,從長計議。想不到當日行動踏入珠寶行,發現售貨員竟然是初戀女友水仙!

programme.title: 青春鼓王
programme.desc: 船員孫志强巧合成爲「火花大樂隊」的鼓手,他因急于成名,答應幫助音樂雜志出版人李源明接近樂隊經理黃麗真,以換取源明的力捧。終于,志强得償所願,一炮而紅,源明却逼他實踐諾言,與麗真斷絕來往。志强受到極大打擊,唯有忍痛離開樂隊與麗真

programme.title: 林沖夜奔
programme.desc: 此片述說了關於林沖的故事。宋朝禁軍教頭林沖遭受貪官陷害,被放逐滄州,更陷入險境。幸得花和尚相助,林沖成功脫險,更展開復仇大計。

programme.title: 青春戀
programme.desc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。

programme.title: 爛頭何
programme.desc: 青年俠盜何真看上歌妓翠紅,翠卻已被京城富豪王親勤包起;王武功高強,深藏不露,實為康熙皇帝第十一子喬裝;王見何為人率直重義氣,且盜亦有道,故何雖多番放肆,王亦不以為忤;何本為官府通緝犯,王卻暗中助其脫身;王此舉無非望何改邪歸正,但何不知收斂,王遂以計制之;後四太子為奪取皇權,把兄弟一一谋殺,特派梁將軍

programme.title: 船
programme.desc: 故事描述一群年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下,組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情。

programme.title: 黑店
programme.desc: 故事講述,江湖上傳出消息,巡撫海剛峰辭官歸里,所攜箱篋中珠寶價值連城,於是引起了一些歹人的覬覦。高家店店主高山峰、其姘婦鄧三娘,以及數幫黑道人物,均於高家店埋伏,準備等待海剛峰經過之時伺機下手…

programme.title: 死角
programme.desc: 故事描述,狄龍與姜大衛游車河時,遇富家女李菁的跑車拋錨,狄載她返家,一見鍾情。後李往姜之修車廠取車,再遇狄,狄約李去跳舞,夜總會中,碰見李兄陳鴻烈,陳不喜歡狄,故二人只好提早離去;歸家途中,目擊員警追捕逃犯,逃犯掉下之手槍,被狄檢到,從此改變他的命?

programme.title: 女殺手
programme.desc: 女殺手被組織控制,強逼去殺商界名人石英,險中殺人滅口的陷阱。她不想淪為殺人工具,決心進行報仇大計,故事曲折離奇

programme.title: 風流斷劍小小刀
programme.desc: 大俠段長青在一小鎮得遇名妓柳銀絮,柳懇求段殺死現以「神醫」為名的黑道高手郭天勝,為其未婚夫報仇。段聯同鎮內賭坊護衛高門殺入郭家,正邪兩派惡鬥連場。

programme.title: 大刀王五
programme.desc: 經營鏢局的大刀王五遇上譚嗣同,這位新黨成員致力於改革清末政府。雖然皇帝支持推行新法,但慈禧太后卻無意交出政權,因此她下令捉拿新黨的所有成員。儘管王五並無政治立場,卻無奈地被捲入這場政治漩渦之中。

programme.title: 青春1000日
programme.desc: 凌玫瑰與方素美是一對感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃,由當舞女之姊撫養成長,方則出身富家,受母呵護備至。畢業後,凌由淪落風塵攀至選美冠軍,方則滿足於平淡生活中;但她們卻偏偏同時愛上劉醫生。最後一件意想不到的事發生,改寫了他們三人的一生…

programme.title: 江湖了斷
programme.desc: 故事描述,羅莽、尹相林、強漢、湯鎮宗及左燕翎五人偷渡赴港時,湯不慎誤踏陷阱,羅等欲救不果,看駐軍逼近,只得舍湯而去。四人到港後,三男淪為黑幫打手,一次私下行劫時,失手被捕入獄。尹、強出獄後即被殺害,督察白彪疑是仇家所為,遂提前釋放羅,企圖引出兇手

programme.title: 大地兒女
programme.desc: 這是一部經典戰爭鉅片,描述抗日戰爭時人民的生活狀況。畫家俞瑞意外救了由鄉下被拐賣來的女子荷花。兩人互生情愫,不久更結為夫妻過著幸福的日子。無奈好景不常,不久日軍全面侵入中國,亦正式展開殘酷的統治…

programme.title: 蕭十一郎
programme.desc: 蕭十一郎被人冒名作惡,送割鹿刀托連城璧殺蕭。寶刀途中被軒轅無敵奪去。軒欲強搶美女沈璧君,蕭英雄救美。蕭行蹤敗露,被連伏擊重傷,幸為沈所救。蕭決意將寶刀取回

programme.title: 金石情
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋,其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿,意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出,孝文感於貞蓮真情,決意回鄉稟明母親,迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後,貞蓮萬念俱灰,竟狂飲毒酒,以圖自盡

programme.title: 奪棍
programme.desc: 一天,絕代棍王紅鷹被惡霸擄走,徒弟阿檬誓要救出師父。途中,阿檬遇上雖貪財,卻武功了得的朱頭炳。在阿檬的利誘下,朱頭炳決定一同出發營救紅鷹。即使二人南轅北轍,但最終仍合力與惡霸終極一戰。

programme.title: 艷陽天
programme.desc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛,常指點她歌唱技巧。小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人,得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧。小芸赴星馬演出,心卻惦念燕南,一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執,怎料汽車失事

programme.title: 吉祥賭坊
programme.desc: 一對青梅竹馬的情侶相隔多年後在神秘的吉祥賭坊相遇,二人決意要一起剷除貪污的將軍、罪犯和勒索者!

programme.title: 佛跳牆

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #3
programme.desc: 非洲大草原有著史詩式的景致,無論是砸頭的河馬,荷爾蒙失調的大象還是決鬥的獅子,席捲大草原的戰鬥都同樣是史詩式的

programme.title: 狒狒:部落的法則
programme.desc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族,好戰的沙漠族,紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因

programme.title: 精靈之國 #2
programme.desc: 遊覽馬達加斯加高聳的山脈,茂密的熱帶雨林,樹木繁茂的沿海平原和乾燥的沙漠看看侏羅紀時代的植物,古老的青蛙和爬行動物物種,以及新的漂流者是如何在這些奇特而美麗的風景中進化的

programme.title: 精靈之國 #3
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加有近400種爬行動物,約佔世界冷血動物的一半觀看變色龍,蛇和300多種五顏六色的青蛙在島上的極端氣候中茁壯成長

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #1 英普
programme.desc: 五月的每天,太陽如常升起從漢波德企鵝到哥倫比亞雨林的猴子,再到太平洋邊緣的科隆群島奇異美洲鬣蜥,美洲熱帶地區的動物已經準備好抵抗酷熱

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #2 英普
programme.desc: 夏至影響亞洲動物,令越南獼猴進入涼快的水中,使鶴在寒冷的青藏高原上跳舞,並激發一種奇怪的魚出來散步

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #3 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #4 英普
programme.desc: 印度次大陸的母親節象徵旱季於斯里蘭卡開始,同時於印度結束對於一隻孟加拉虎媽媽來說,是時候訓練她的幼崽去狩獵了,而獅子和眼鏡蛇則忙於交配

programme.title: 海灘生命線 #6
programme.desc: 加州的海灘是世上最美麗的海灘之一,但由於人類對大自然的影響,它們是否會失去平衡?太平洋海岸壯麗的動物群如何在海灘生命線上繼續生活?

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾的南部邊界,有著世上獨一無二最大的熱帶濕地,野生動植物的多樣性使科學家們爭相瞭解動物的各種互動方式博多克納山的高地是隱密的潘塔納爾濕地的入口那裡的水十分清澈,因由超過6億年歷史的石灰岩所形成過濾層,為這些溪流中的生命提供了一個清晰的門戶 瀑布,凝灰岩水壩,洞穴和純淨的河流,能見

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #2 英普
programme.desc: 潘塔納爾的南部濕地於每年都成為鳥類天堂,超過650種珍稀和標誌性的鳥類在繁殖季節中聚集

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的中心,有一個人跡罕至的偏遠地區沒有人為干預,使這裡成為三百隻馳名的白唇西貒的棲息地這些大型類豬哺乳類動物能長到四十五公斤,下巴下有白色條紋,因獨特外觀而得名

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #4 英普
programme.desc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地

programme.title: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 英普
programme.desc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #4
programme.desc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵

programme.title: 狂野天空 #1 英普
programme.desc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧

programme.title: 狂野天空 #2 英普
programme.desc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風

programme.desc: 歡迎來到印度- 充滿異國的動物和異國的戰事猴子打得塵土飛揚,印度黑羚在開闊的平原上全面開戰,孔雀哥兒開屏比拼:這些多姿多彩的戰鬥襯得上充滿活力的土地

programme.desc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕

programme.title: 非洲視「野」 #1
programme.desc: 南非的塞德堡山脈是一片多年來由風,水和火雕琢而成的奇石地貌這些壯觀的山峰是眾多不同植物和動物的家但這裡亦有些看不見的東西,墊伏在陰暗處伺機攻擊

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #3
programme.desc: 非洲大草原有著史詩式的景致,無論是砸頭的河馬,荷爾蒙失調的大象還是決鬥的獅子,席捲大草原的戰鬥都同樣是史詩式的

programme.title: 狒狒:部落的法則
programme.desc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族,好戰的沙漠族,紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因

programme.title: 精靈之國 #2
programme.desc: 遊覽馬達加斯加高聳的山脈,茂密的熱帶雨林,樹木繁茂的沿海平原和乾燥的沙漠看看侏羅紀時代的植物,古老的青蛙和爬行動物物種,以及新的漂流者是如何在這些奇特而美麗的風景中進化的

programme.title: 精靈之國 #3
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加有近400種爬行動物,約佔世界冷血動物的一半觀看變色龍,蛇和300多種五顏六色的青蛙在島上的極端氣候中茁壯成長

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #1 英普
programme.desc: 五月的每天,太陽如常升起從漢波德企鵝到哥倫比亞雨林的猴子,再到太平洋邊緣的科隆群島奇異美洲鬣蜥,美洲熱帶地區的動物已經準備好抵抗酷熱

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #2 英普
programme.desc: 夏至影響亞洲動物,令越南獼猴進入涼快的水中,使鶴在寒冷的青藏高原上跳舞,並激發一種奇怪的魚出來散步

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #3 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #4 英普
programme.desc: 印度次大陸的母親節象徵旱季於斯里蘭卡開始,同時於印度結束對於一隻孟加拉虎媽媽來說,是時候訓練她的幼崽去狩獵了,而獅子和眼鏡蛇則忙於交配

programme.title: 海灘生命線 #6
programme.desc: 加州的海灘是世上最美麗的海灘之一,但由於人類對大自然的影響,它們是否會失去平衡?太平洋海岸壯麗的動物群如何在海灘生命線上繼續生活?

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾的南部邊界,有著世上獨一無二最大的熱帶濕地,野生動植物的多樣性使科學家們爭相瞭解動物的各種互動方式博多克納山的高地是隱密的潘塔納爾濕地的入口那裡的水十分清澈,因由超過6億年歷史的石灰岩所形成過濾層,為這些溪流中的生命提供了一個清晰的門戶 瀑布,凝灰岩水壩,洞穴和純淨的河流,能見

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #2 英普
programme.desc: 潘塔納爾的南部濕地於每年都成為鳥類天堂,超過650種珍稀和標誌性的鳥類在繁殖季節中聚集

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的中心,有一個人跡罕至的偏遠地區沒有人為干預,使這裡成為三百隻馳名的白唇西貒的棲息地這些大型類豬哺乳類動物能長到四十五公斤,下巴下有白色條紋,因獨特外觀而得名

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #4 英普
programme.desc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地

programme.title: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 英普
programme.desc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #4
programme.desc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵

programme.title: 狂野天空 #1 英普
programme.desc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧

programme.title: 狂野天空 #2 英普
programme.desc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #4
programme.desc: 歡迎來到印度- 充滿異國的動物和異國的戰事猴子打得塵土飛揚,印度黑羚在開闊的平原上全面開戰,孔雀哥兒開屏比拼:這些多姿多彩的戰鬥襯得上充滿活力的土地

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #3
programme.desc: 沉浸在地球上最大,保存最完整的稀樹草原之中;在那裡,哺乳動物和昆蟲都能毫不費力地飛掠空中了解傳統的野火管理方法,探索一處砂岩避難地,並看著一隻蜜袋鼯試著逃離火焰

programme.title: 野火劫後 英普
programme.desc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然

programme.title: 動物知心友 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #5
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王

programme.title: 動物解碼 #1 英普
programme.desc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 在鬣狗家族中有一個新面孔 斑斑註定要成為位於尚比亞盧安瓜谷心臟地帶斑鬣狗族群的首領她自出生起已有崇高身份,但她仍然需要證明自己族群是一個危險的地方,她必須為自己打出一席位

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #5 英普
programme.desc: 脆弱又難以捉摸的豹貓在許多國家都屬於瀕危物種但在世上最大的熱帶濕地之一的潘塔納爾濕地的南部邊界,這種驚豔的野貓似乎打算捲土重來一群年輕的野生動物科學家正試圖瞭解原因

programme.title: 野火劫後 英普
programme.desc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #2

programme.title: 維修的奧秘 2 #7
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣前往世上最大的自動化包裹分類設施 - 位於肯塔基州路易維爾的聯合包裹服務公司世界港每天有200萬個包裹途經這裡,全靠幕後一班戴著安全帽的英雄實現這一切

programme.title: 維修的奧秘 2 #8
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道,隧道,軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大,最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作

programme.title: 沖繩島戰役彩色紀錄
programme.desc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲

programme.title: 中途島海戰:真實故事
programme.desc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #1
programme.desc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞,現代的高爾夫球場,神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #2
programme.desc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈,繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #3
programme.desc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠,巨大的鑽石和 世上最大的內陸綠洲之上

programme.desc: 從數千英尺高空探索西開普省迷人的海岸線,注目的山脈和多樣性的大都會

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機

programme.title: 野外的一年:阿拉斯加 #1
programme.desc: 冬季的結束預示世上最大型又瘋狂的覓食潮來臨,大型海洋獵食者瞄準在阿拉斯加灣尋求庇護的數百萬條魚

programme.title: 灰熊的故事:雙孤記
programme.desc: 凱西安達臣撫養一隻名叫砵突士的熊孤兒18年後,將盡一切努力確保沒有熊生活在人造庇護所中有一年,當他得知有兩隻灰熊幼崽成為孤兒後,他的決心受到考驗

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: Stepping Out
programme.desc: China is usually seen through the lens of economics, politics and a regimented population But in Stepping Out we meet people who have left home and set out on the road to discover their China and themselves Su Min, who feels she has done her duty as daughter, wife, mother and grandmother and in her 50’s left her abusive husband; Kiwi, a two-year-old whose parents lost their jobs in the pandemic and not owning a house, travel China in their RV as a family; and Alex a graphic designer exploring his country with his retired mother Through their travels and their lives, we see a different life in China – a freedom to travel, explore, visit amazing places but taking all the benefits of technology to promote themselves and make a living The film was made in July 2022 by students from CUC Nanjing and is directed by their tutor

programme.title: Super Senses
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 順德「姑婆屋」原來大有來頭，媽姐過往被戲稱「土鯪魚」，因為「骨多又惡啃」？且聽廖Sir細說早年自梳風氣。明星謝賢曾於粵語片飾演飛機欖小販，廣州現時的「雞公欖達人」可會同樣俊俏不凡？「麻甩佬」形容市井男人，但麻甩一詞竟是來自浪漫法國？「坐冷板凳」、「拍床拍蓆」意境生動，實則隱喻昔日塘西「阿姑」的坎坷生活。「土魷」、「豬膶」說法講求意頭，化身侍應的蕭博士還會鬼馬解讀「咕嚕肉」、「啫啫雞」的菜名由來。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 路過城隍廟要求好籤，位於廣州的都城隍廟不但歷史悠久，背景又如何巴閉？「水鬼升城隍」形容小人得志，廖Sir卻帶來「好人有好報」的講法，並化身「解籤佬」細說靈籤解讀方法。傳統婚禮習俗多，「戥穿石」竟然真有其石！新潮大妗姐示範新娘上頭步驟；還有史學專家施志明道出拜七姐求姻緣的典故。智堅、美恩來到佛山「揮春街」擺檔寫揮春，期間卻錯解諺語，貽笑大方。今集亦百無禁忌，大談「冬瓜豆腐」、「賣鹹鴨蛋」的俗語由來。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 原宿色彩繽紛的餐廳，設立目的只為了一位名人？三藩市某餐廳每半小時「天降異象」，令人大驚！韓國集三款口味的長薄餅，可以有多長？楊明、葉翠翠、陳庭欣、黃子恆進行一番運氣大戰，「命水夠好」便能享用法國鵝肝！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 聖地牙哥有餐廳不提供任何餐具，如何盛載食物？經常變形的海腸，應如何處理才可以食用？東京有餐廳以五盅食物作為鎮店之寶，究竟是甚麼平凡食材？Do姐與馬蹄露、袁偉豪及農夫一起憑錦囊猜題，竟顯示出她的高智慧！

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，了解最偉大科學家的生活，了解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，了解最偉大科學家的生活，了解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 星夢頻道樂園的新影樓準備開張，在四眼哥哥安排下，奇蹟閃耀組與Meltic StAr將要展開一場模特兒對決，憑拍攝出來的照片分出高下。Meltic StAr的攝影師是阿讓，奇蹟閃耀組的攝影師則是愛麗絲，勝利的殊榮將會花落誰家？

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄聽了老師的格言，覺得很感動，但其他人聽他覆述卻無動於衷，多啦A夢於是借他「感動擴音器」。多啦A夢對漫畫《獅面人》的後續感到好奇，坐時光機去到未來追看，詎料靈感枯竭的作者視他為救星。

programme.title: 少女煮意日常粵日
programme.desc: 飲食文化研究會決定在大學祭擺攤，在農業學會支持下，大家終於想出一道別出心裁的菜式。另一邊廂，為了讓奈奈能夠招待客人，躑躅跟她展開一場克服怕生的特訓。如是者，很快來到大學祭當日……

programme.title: 一路繁花粵
programme.desc: 位於上海外灘的飯店，是劇集《繁花》的主要場景。主持胡蓓蔚、姚子羚前往打卡，乘搭近百年歷史的古老趟閘電梯。除了享用蟹黃盛宴，她們還於黃埔江夜景襯托下打邊爐，讓觀眾感受這夜繁花繾綣。子羚二人到訪劇中「至真園」的原型，獲餐廳老闆娘悉心款待。她們會合後輩冼靖峰，在黃河路上的老字號粵菜館用餐，劇內「爺叔」喜愛的「定勝糕」有多滋味？此外，鍾鎮濤在港拜訪名廚，了解「仙鶴神針」、「船王炒飯」等劇中美饌的故事。

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 要將罐頭食材改頭換面，注入新驚喜，實在有難度。保哥隊的Ken、Ricky隊的Kyle先抽選兩組罐頭，再巧手煮出宴客佳餚！Ken要於限時內完成康堤芝士卷配甜酸番茄醬、鯪魚日本米紫菜天婦羅、午餐肉桃駁李青瓜卷等料理，已經夠緊迫，期間還遇上溫度計失靈，點算好？除了奉上炭燒沙甸魚春卷、鹹牛肉焗飯之外，做甜品出身的Kyle更即場製作南北杏黃桃雪糕，令「平民」評判張振朗忍不住要搶先試味，並笑稱要畀「夠薑分」！

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 六強煮將躋身第二回合「隊長挑戰賽」，角逐兩個決賽名額！命運弄人下，菲菲偏偏抽中師父Ricky，這��師徒大戰以「港式情懷菜」作較量。炸沙翁製作費時，菲菲用皇牌邀保哥幫手，怎料被師父出招叫停，兩師徒都無情講？她將辣酒煮海鮮包裝成西式下午茶上碟，賣相夠精緻，味道又怎樣？甫聞Ricky會帶來大菜蛋、碗仔翅，嘉賓黃智賢滿心期待，笑言立即加分！Ricky忙着完成焗豬扒飯，卻仍擔心菲菲的進度，更替她請援兵……

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 劉溫馨有一套獨特的消暑心得，一杯熱檸水何以成為當中的關鍵？享受清涼甜品亦不失為一種理想消暑方法，古嘉俊邀請了溫馨合作炮製一款「咖啡車厘子黃梅蛋糕」，以鮮果混和咖啡芳香，炮製出透心涼的「溫馨」感覺。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 雛子救走了零時的意識，並告訴他全件事的真相。零時被送返現實中的身體，太晴亦順利甦醒。適逢聖誕節，一班駕駛員聚在一起慶祝。伊奈借醉向零時說出心底話。比娜看似心事重重，其後更失蹤。

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日

programme.desc: 位於上海外灘的飯店，是劇集《繁花》的主要場景。主持胡蓓蔚、姚子羚前往打卡，乘搭近百年歷史的古老趟閘電梯。除了享用蟹黃盛宴，她們還於黃埔江夜景襯托下打邊爐，讓觀眾感受這夜繁花繾綣。子羚二人到訪劇中「至真園」的原型，獲餐廳老闆娘悉心款待。她們會合後輩冼靖峰，在黃河路上的老字號粵菜館用餐，劇內「爺叔」喜愛的「定勝糕」有多滋味？此外，鍾鎮濤在港拜訪名廚，了解「仙鶴神針」、「船王炒飯」等劇中美饌的故事。

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 要將罐頭食材改頭換面，注入新驚喜，實在有難度。保哥隊的Ken、Ricky隊的Kyle先抽選兩組罐頭，再巧手煮出宴客佳餚！Ken要於限時內完成康堤芝士卷配甜酸番茄醬、鯪魚日本米紫菜天婦羅、午餐肉桃駁李青瓜卷等料理，已經夠緊迫，期間還遇上溫度計失靈，點算好？除了奉上炭燒沙甸魚春卷、鹹牛肉焗飯之外，做甜品出身的Kyle更即場製作南北杏黃桃雪糕，令「平民」評判張振朗忍不住要搶先試味，並笑稱要畀「夠薑分」！

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 六強煮將躋身第二回合「隊長挑戰賽」，角逐兩個決賽名額！命運弄人下，菲菲偏偏抽中師父Ricky，這場師徒大戰以「港式情懷菜」作較量。炸沙翁製作費時，菲菲用皇牌邀保哥幫手，怎料被師父出招叫停，兩師徒都無情講？她將辣酒煮海鮮包裝成西式下午茶上碟，賣相夠精緻，味道又怎樣？甫聞Ricky會帶來大菜蛋、碗仔翅，嘉賓黃智賢滿心期待，笑言立即加分！Ricky忙着完成焗豬扒飯，卻仍擔心菲菲的進度，更替她請援兵……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 家長或會擔心孩童長得矮小，兒科醫生細說監察生長速度的注意事項。外地流行「增高針」，背後有何醫學原理？另可考慮皮下注射生長激素，而日常充足睡眠、適量運動亦對長高有幫助。藝人溫碧霞前來分享工作近況，還透露錄了三首「AI音樂」，與時並進！她坦言婚前一直為事業拼搏，組織家庭和經歷父親離世後開始學懂放慢腳步。她亦自揭曾與丈夫分開，走過低谷後感情更昇華？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓聯同兩位主持炮製「芝麻醬蔬菜鱔件」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 如出現便秘、大便有血等徵狀，就要留意可會是大腸癌的先兆。時裝達人鄧達智以「過來人」身分，述說擊退大腸癌的經歷。傳統診斷大腸健康的照內窺鏡檢查，近年結合AI技術，精準度有所提升，專科醫生帶來科創新知。此外，非入侵性的檢測有何選擇？及早發現大腸癌，患者可採用的治療方案亦更多。同樣結合AI的新式手術治療，可讓早期病人不需切除患癌腸段，詳情怎樣？達智還會分享其抗病補品，也有營養師帶來有助腸道健康的雜菜湯。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#6粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚發現高哲表弟譚彬是麻省理工電腦天才，亦知高哲欲偷英杰的血鑽。高哲集團本成功偷取血鑽，但被他無意中破壞。高哲在酒店遇上找錯房間的蓉蓉母子；關仁把大海和安娜反鎖酒店房間，正當明翔等人偷血鑽之際，突傳來警鐘聲，原來大海刻意觸動火災感應器，俠盜集團未能得逞。英杰過關時扮肚痛，讓蓉蓉獨自過關。高哲和蓉蓉打招呼時偷去她身上血鑽，關仁詐病令高哲趁亂棄賊贓。蓉蓉向美莉表示高哲愛上自己，後終解釋清楚是誤會一場。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 脂肪瘤是一種常見的良性軟組織腫瘤，多數無痛且生長緩慢，但整形外科醫生提醒，若脂肪瘤體積快速增大、質地變硬或伴隨疼痛，患者宜盡快求醫。坊間有稱體型肥胖人士較易出現脂肪瘤，醫生有何看法？許美德師傅引領大王與菲比享用精緻粵菜，用料矜貴且創意十足。將花膠炸脆搭配魚子醬，乾燒遼參加上可口脆米，還有用威士忌煮老菜脯與波士頓龍蝦，展現粵菜的創新魅力。「睇餸食飯」，三姐帶來夏日佳餚「荔枝蝦球」，味道酸甜又清新。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵

programme.desc: 戚幹跌在神經漢身上，幸只傷一腿，江霞命大偉往醫院探視，同事見大偉的態度不禁奇怪。大偉時往探視戚幹，終忍不住與他相認，戚幹大感疑惑，往找一帆證實。大偉將住址交給戚幹，戚幹終鼓起勇氣往找江霞，二人一起在家中吃飯，戚幹感霞賢淑，暗自高興。大偉將調升為指揮官，李Sir著大偉與戚幹等一起出外辦案，汲取經驗。大偉與戚幹等扮成各式各樣人物，等候毒販出現一網成擒，不意雲蒂被非禮，身份敗露，毒販乘機逃走，無功而返。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 脂肪瘤是一種常見的良性軟組織腫瘤，多數無痛且生長緩慢，但整形外科醫生提醒，若脂肪瘤體積快速增大、質地變硬或伴隨疼痛，患者宜盡快求醫。坊間有稱體型肥胖人士較易出現脂肪瘤，醫生有何看法？許美德師傅引領大王與菲比享用精緻粵菜，用料矜貴且創意十足。將花膠炸脆搭配魚子醬，乾燒遼參加上可口脆米，還有用威士忌煮老菜脯與波士頓龍蝦，展現粵菜的創新魅力。「睇餸食飯」，三姐帶來夏日佳餚「荔枝蝦球」，味道酸甜又清新。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 為治療椎間盤突出的痛症，有醫院引入微創手術機械人，永城、何沛珈還有幸走進手術室見證機械人的首次手術。以機械人輔助做椎間融合手術，有何優點？睡姿或影響脊骨健康，脊醫細談正確睡姿，以及揀選枕頭的學問。體重過輕、皮膚偏白是骨質疏鬆症的風險因子？這集請來李思雅、吳沚默接受骨質密度檢查，兩藝員的報告指數竟頗有差距！不妨參加強骨運動班，有助大家改善情況。負重訓練真的可增加骨質密度嗎？醫學院學者從細胞角度解釋。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#7粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚和尚武在師傅死忌當日一起拜祭，尚武希望江揚破案兼為他打倒心魔。美莉為保蓉蓉，刻意和她一組推銷基金。關仁拒絕高哲送的大額支票，高哲只好藏在其衣物中。君豪取得血鑽製成首飾「宇宙之星」，更打算拍賣並以高價買回，借機洗黑錢。譚彬、明翔、喜善都不想拆夥，關仁指出高哲是為大家著想。大海在酒吧見到眾俠盜，要求當眾搜身，混亂中觸到明翔胸部，被譚彬拍下，江揚、高哲針鋒相對。高哲終決定和眾人一起偷「宇宙之星」。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#125粵
programme.desc: 朋接過根的鐵盒後提心吊膽，根更提到鐵盒關乎民族大義。花來訪高家，根不欲連累親妹而逃跑，黑衣人出現，揭發盒內藏著由蘇根從博物館偷出來的最後一屆長洲搶包山的壽包。根怪花破壞他的好事，與花斷絕兄妹關係。

programme.title: 夢華錄#30粵普
programme.desc: 千帆夜深進宮見皇后，欲說服她幫助洗脫污名。盼兒決意再去告歐陽旭，正當要再受杖刑之際，官家宣佈可以三十貫錢贖刑，眾人合力湊錢，終讓盼兒免受杖刑之苦。歐陽旭在公堂上死不認罪，此時引章趕到，拿出決定性證據…

programme.title: 我係小廚神3粵
programme.desc: 今集主題是「蛋」，食材簡單， 8位小廚神竟弄得一團糟！小廚神做了甚麼，令專業評判不罵不行？Cyrus、Cindy都在菜式中加入「魔鬼蛋」，兩者概念不同，同樣令星級評判黎諾懿大讚。今集大多數人都表現失色，兩顆「小廚神星章」最終落在誰身上？主持帶小廚神到街市，分三組執行特別買餸任務，竟有人做出令人滴汗行為！接着拜訪分子料理高人，吃過嶄新的分子菜式後，小廚神動手創作分子小菜，作品卻是不堪入目！

programme.desc: 單純直率的豆小鴨總是不小心闖禍，還好他有最棒的好朋友－－善解人意的袋熊沃蓓，和熱愛發明的小豬奇姆！只要三個人在一起，不管遇到任何困難，都能運用創意找到有趣的方法解決，把日常生活的所有危機，變成精彩好玩的大冒險！快快快，一起來山谷洞玩吧！

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 不像三兄弟

programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - doctorcos snow white water glow mask
programme.desc: 9-in-1 beauty cream that moisturizes and strengthens the elasticity of your skin. 雪白保湿脸霜，让你肌肤提升保湿力、更显年轻！

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - HOTO Electric Spin Scrubber
programme.desc: The Hoto Kitchen Spin Scrubber combines power and precision in a compact, cordless design made for everyday kitchen cleaning. Equipped with a high speed motor and built in rechargeable battery, it removes grease, stains and buildup from sinks, stovetops and countertops effortlessly. 一款无线高扭矩清洁器，为轻松，深层清洁而设计。它可伸缩手柄与6种可替换刷头，轻松清洁地板，瓷砖，浴缸及狭小角落。简约奢华设计，适合每个人使用。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Clynn by Nature Hair Regrowth Bundle
programme.desc: A simple, plant based organic three-step system designed to naturally restore scalp health, block DHT, and revive dormant roots for noticeably thicker, fuller hair. Safe for anyone above 4 yrs old and stop Excessive Hair Shedding in One Week! 一款天然有机的植物萃取养护头皮头发系统，有助于恢复头皮健康、抑制双氢睾酮（DHT），并激活休眠毛囊，让秀发显著加密更显丰盈。安全温和，4岁以上人群均可放心使用，助您在短短一周内有效减少过度掉发！

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Nature’s Farm Pycnogenol
programme.desc: Nature’s Farm Pycnogenol® is a premium antioxidant supplement made from 100% pure French Maritime Pine Bark extract (100mg), sourced exclusively from the Les Landes de Gascogne forest in France. Supported by over 160 clinical trials and 450 scientific studies, it helps fight oxidative stress and promotes overall wellness—benefiting the brain, eyes, heart, joints, skin, and blood sugar balance for all ages. NatureFarm's碧容健®，源自法国滨海松树皮萃取物，是一款高效天然抗氧化营养品。经过160项临床试验与450篇科学研究验证，全面帮助抵御氧化压力，守护大脑、眼睛、心脏、关节、肌肤及血糖健康，适合各年龄层日常保健

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Naturalle Sugar Care Tea
programme.desc: Crafted from 100% natural leaves including gymnema, mulberry and green tea, the Naturalle Sugar Care tea is mild-flavoured and low in calories. A perfect post-meal beverage, this tea may help curb sugar cravings and support healthy post-meal blood sugar levels, making it great for individuals who frequently consume carbohydrate-rich or sugary foods. Naturalle 糖适宁茶采用 100% 天然叶材精制而成，包括匙羹藤、桑叶与绿茶，口感清淡、低热量。糖适宁茶是适合餐后饮用，有助于抑制对甜食的渴望和维持血糖健康水平，非常适合经常摄取高碳水或含糖食物的人士饮用

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Thomson Probiotic
programme.desc: Thomson ProbioGut is a premium probiotic supplement designed to support digestive health, boost immunity, and promote overall well-being. Formulated with two clinically researched Japanese probiotic strains—it helps improve gut flora, regulate bowel movements, and maintain a healthy body weight. Thomson ProbioGut 是一款优质的益生菌补充剂，专为支持消化健康、增强免疫力和促进整体健康而设计。采用两种临床研究认证的日本益生菌菌株— 有助于改善肠道菌群、调节排便，并维持健康的体重

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Ellixi Hair Tonic
programme.desc: Revitalize your hair with Ellixi Hair Tonic — your ultimate solution for stronger, healthier, and more vibrant locks. Infused with a powerful blend of natural botanical extracts, essential oils, and vital nutrients, Ellixi helps to promote growth, and helps reduce hair fall. Whether you're battling thinning, dryness, or dullness, this lightweight tonic nourishes the scalp and restores shine without leaving any residue. 护发要趁早！Ellixi打造更健康、更亮丽秀发。Ellixi 纯天然植物萃取、含精油和有助于护发的重要营养素，有助于促进头发生长，减少脱发。无论您是头发稀疏、干燥问题，或是希望保持浓密秀发，Ellixi都能帮助你滋养头皮，恢复秀发光泽，且不留任何残留。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Tupperware Freezable 5-Container Set
programme.desc: The Tupperware Freezable 5-Container Set makes meal prep and long-term storage easy, locking in freshness and flavour. Tupperware's No. 1 freezing containers feature a speedy-freeze design and flexible material for easy unmolding. Available in multiple sizes, there's a perfect container for every freezer storage need. Tupperware 冷冻保鲜 5 件套让备餐和长期储存变得便捷，有效锁住食物的新鲜度。作为 Tupperware 畅销第一的冷冻容器，它采用快速冷冻设计与柔韧材质，冷冻后轻松脱模。多种尺寸组合，能轻松满足各种冷冻储存的需求。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Nature's Farm® Mirtogenol Plus+
programme.desc: Nature’s Farm Mirtogenol Plus+ is a clinically tested eye health formula developed by ophthalmologists and scientists from the UK and Italy. Powered by two powerful antioxidants—Pycnogenol® and Mirtoselect®—with Citrus Bioflavonoids, it supports healthy eye pressure, improves microcirculation, and helps protect against daily screen-related eye stress. It helps reduce eye fatigue, dryness, and blurred vision for clearer, more comfortable vision. Nature’s Farm Mirtogenol Plus+ 为眼科医生及英意科研团队研发的临床护眼配方，结合两大强效抗氧化成分 Pycnogenol® 法国松树皮与 Mirtoselect® 欧洲蓝莓，并添加柑橘类黄酮，有助改善眼部微循环、支持健康眼压、对抗用眼压力与氧化损伤，缓解眼睛干涩、疲劳与模糊感，让视力更清晰、更舒适。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Kplass Cough and Flu Relief Patch
programme.desc: Drug-free patches use Far Infrared and acupoint therapy to relieve cold and flu symptoms naturally. The Cold & Flu Patch eases a blocked nose, sinus pressure and chills. The Cough Relief Patch comes in adult and child versions to soothe coughs and calm throat irritation for easier breathing. Safe for daily use, they offer up to 6 hours of comfort for the whole family. 无需药物的贴布，结合远红外线和穴位疗法，自然缓解感冒症状。感冒缓解贴舒缓鼻塞、流鼻涕、鼻窦压力和寒冷不适。止咳贴有成人装和儿童装，帮助缓解咳嗽、喉咙不适，同时促进血液循环，让呼吸更顺畅、睡眠更安心。温和贴肤，每天可用，长达6小时舒适守护，全家都适用。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Acerpure Clean V2 Cordless Vacuum Cleaner
programme.desc: Transform the way you clean with the Acerpure Clean V2 cordless vacuum, designed for modern living. programme.title: You Cant Win Em All
programme.desc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA

Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Sam the Snowplough clears the streets
programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Horaci the Inuit
programme.desc: Packed with adventure, fun and excitement, HORACI THE INUIT will transport you to the Lands of the North where, together with his best friend Sedna, he will have to solve all kinds of mysteries! Horaci the Inuit takes place in a remote village and talks about universal values such as caring for nature, being intuitive and open-minded and, above all, having a loving respect for family and friends!

programme.title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!

programme.title: Chefclub Kids
programme.desc: With Chefclub Kids, the little ones get their hands dirty all while having fun in the kitchen. Whether they're learning to prepare dinner, bake goodies, or explore new flavors, Chefclub Kids is a way for children to gain confidence through cooking!

programme.title: Hogie the Globehopper
programme.desc: Hogie the Globehopper is a fun tv show that will inspire a curiosity and fascination about the world and its people. Hogie and his friends Lorna, Bernie and Floaty travel the world, making lots of friends along the way.

programme.title: Bernard - Bernard - At The North Pole
programme.desc: Bernard gets bored trekking across the frozen Arctic wastes. Some abandoned equipment becomes a source of great entertainment, but not for long.

programme.title: Bernard - Bernard - The Package
programme.desc: Zack tries to steal a parcel which Bernard is carrying. At first he succeeds, but Bernard doesn't give up that easily.

programme.title: Bernard - Bernard - Sleepwalker

programme.title: Bernard - Bernard - The Unicycle

programme.title: Bernard - Bernard - The Motorboat

programme.title: Bernard - Bernard - The Prisoner

programme.title: Brain Candy TV

programme.title: Yeti Tales

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Wonderfully Beautiful
programme.desc: Ranging from a 60-year-old retiree who no longer finds herself desirable to a daughter trying to make her breakthrough as a model, five women of different ages confront their self-image and the expectation they have for themselves and the people around them.

programme.title: Not My Type
programme.desc: A dashing philosopher is sent off to teach in a quiet northern town, where he soon falls for a bubbly and rather vulgar local hairdresser. But will the couple’s carnal affection manage to overcome their irreconcilable differences?

programme.title: Bille
programme.desc: In late 1930s Latvia, young Bille grows up in poverty, caught between her mother’s contempt and her father’s alcoholism. Escaping into books and her imagination, she dreams of a better world as she embarks on her path to becoming a celebrated writer.

programme.title: East Frisian: Rage
programme.desc: A fisherman discovers a body in the mudflats at the same time Inspector Ann Kathrin Klaasen is called to investigate a blackmail case. With the latter involving threats to poison the water supply, she begins to suspect that both cases might be connected.

programme.title: Death Of Nintendo
programme.desc: In 90s Manila, as blackouts from the looming volcanic eruption disrupts their video game-filled days, four friends go on a journey of self-discovery. For Paolo, it’s a quest to impress the popular girl; for Mimaw, it’s the painful start of finding herself.

programme.title: Hard Shell, Soft Shell
programme.desc: Loved-up oyster farmer Az thinks he’s made it. But when an elaborate proposal goes awry and his girlfriend Jess breaks his heart, Az is forced to confront his understanding of what happiness really looks like – both hers and his own.

programme.title: Romancing The Jungle
programme.desc: Eva is a rookie journalist keen on investigating sea piracy. When she is really kidnapped by pirates in Thailand, she is forced to fight for her life. With her is a hunky smuggler called Nik, and together, the comedic duo band together to survive.

programme.desc: Through the eyes of Diana, we witness the rollercoaster ride of both her parent’s and Irene’s marriages. To both girls, they have the worst parents in the world. But at the end of the day, which of the couples remain strong and which fall apart ?

programme.desc: As they near forty, three childhood friends reunite in their hometown. As both pleasant and painful memories of their shared past resurfaces, the trio is forced to confront the fractured families, unspoken wounds, and lives they’ve quietly settled for.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

The baby birds follow the grown-ups so they know where to go, and then they remember the way for the rest of their lives.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Whistler Mountain, Canada
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are on Whistler Mountain in Canada doing some skiing and checking out the amazing cable car which runs high up between the mountains.

programme.desc: Tao asks Mojo and Bo to help him film an action-packed snowboarding video, but Mojo is not so steady on the slopes. Which top can they swap to grab the white-hot snow shots?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Chickening
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to carry Jackson's big blue 'chicken' Ludwig (who definitely isn't a chicken) to the country fair. But the easily-startled bird gets away from them - the chase is on!

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Cheese Moon
programme.desc: It's a space race to fulfil Carrot's dream of being the first Veggie on the cheese moon.

programme.desc: Supertato is determined to rescue Tomato's precious jewel after Evil Pea steals it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Camping Badge

They all work together and finally get settled. Then things start to unravel when the squirrels hear a scary noise outside the tent. What can it be? All sorts of things are imagined. DUGGEE!!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Making Friends Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The River Badge

programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Amazon Rain Forest, South America
programme.desc: Glitch wants a picnic so he stops the rain in the rainforest, upsetting the local tree frogs.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Copycat
programme.desc: Bluey's having fun copying everything Dad says and does, but the game takes a serious turn when Bluey finds a hurt budgie and they have to make an emergency trip to the vet.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bin Night
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Dad always take out the bins. Over a few weeks, Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her and Mum offers some good advice.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Andy's Safari Adventures S01 - Andy and The Manakin
programme.desc: Andy heads to Central America in search of the manakin bird, so he can learn its amazing dance moves.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Tubes
programme.desc: Bella and Lift enjoy making funny honk noises with tubes. They visit Tincy the Spider, who uses terrific tubes to make music with the Playtimers.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Breakfast Badge
programme.desc: Tag's feeling grumpy because he didn't eat his breakfast, uh-oh! Luckily Duggee has his Breakfast Badge, and soon the Squirrels will too.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Opposites Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels have fun learning what opposites are, with a little bit of help from a lot of topsy-turvy animal friends!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Radio Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels stumble upon some of Duggee's old radio equipment and decide to start their own show.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Chinese New Year, Dragon Dance Drama
programme.desc: Kyan's invited to perform a dragon dance for Chinese New Year in Beijing. Glitch decides to build a fire breathing dragon robot for the parade and The Go Jetters need to stop it!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Whale Rescue
programme.desc: After a pod of pilot whales becomes stranded at the Academy beach, the Go Jetters, with help from new teacher Professor Wave, must work fast to return them to the ocean deeps. But with Glitch's camouflaged submarine zooming around the nearby waters, the situation quickly becomes more complicated.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: While working on the Chinese railway, Thomas misses his friend Percy, and takes a trip down the memory lane.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Arcade Dance Off
programme.desc: Stumbling across an arcade, Sarah takes on a dancing challenge with John, whilst Duck and Flamingo team up to try and defeat a video game!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Mars As Moon
programme.desc: Mars tries to fill in for a missing Moon, but needs a little coaching from Sarah and Duck.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Delivery
programme.desc: Stanley helps Hattie, Fred, and Fifi with a new food delivery service. It starts well, except with each delivery a problem arises. Stanley must solve them before Myrtle's party.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Moon
programme.desc: Stan helps his friends to get a closer look at the moon through a telescope, so they can do a show-and-tell.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Don't Like Bananas
programme.desc: From broccoli soup to cheeseburgers and blue cheese, the funny animals chat about the best and worst things to eat.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S02 - It's Time to Visit the Art Gallery
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit the art gallery and join a tour with curator Marie to see lots of different types of art. JoJo realises art isn't just for looking at - it's for making too!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Mythical Creature Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find a hidden book about mythical creatures. They learn and discover a wide range of mythical creatures, create their own and find out why the book was hidden in the first place.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Puzzle Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are close to finishing a jigsaw puzzle when the Naughty Mice steal their last piece. To get it back, they must take part in a series of puzzles in an underground adventure set by the Puzzle Mouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Sahara Desert, Africa
programme.desc: Glitch makes a sandcastle around an oasis in the Sahara. Can the Go Jetters save the day?

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Raspberry

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Pineapple

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Pea's Power Suit
programme.desc: Evil Pea becomes more powerful than Supertato by wearing a giant powersuit.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Double Doughnut Rescue
programme.desc: Supertato almost quits being a superhero when he can't save two friends at the same time.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Sliding Down
programme.desc: The Tubby Car takes the Teletubbies to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Slidey. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po have great fun sliding down again and again.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S06 - Strawberry
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'strawberry', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We grow strawberries, pick them and enjoy eating yummy ones. There are skipping and space strawberries, and Dee even does the samba with one! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Messy's Lost Balloon
programme.desc: Messy loves balloons, whatever colour they are, but what is inside them to make them float up high into the sky?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Breakdown Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan the ferry can't shut his engine off, so he's speeding out of control around the lake. How will Mojo and Bo get aboard to take control and steer Bryan to safety?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.desc: The Tubby Car takes the Teletubbies to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Slidey. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po have great fun sliding down again and again.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: The film is about a Chinese martial arts school finds itself outclassed by their rivals, they hire elite ninja from Japan to destroy the school. The lone survivor of the massacre learns the secrets of ninjutsu and seeks revenge against the ninja.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he'd still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tai's best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiancé. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all…

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all…

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world…

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nu's elder sister hopes to restore the clan's honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it…

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Yi Dai Jiang Shi - EP23
